{
  "problem": "The user needs a design for a minimal REST API to manage tasks, expressed as a JSON specification.",
  "objectives": [
    "Define a minimal set of RESTful endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks",
    "Specify the data model for a task with recommended fields: id, title, description, completed, createdAt, updatedAt",
    "Specify HTTP methods, URL paths, request/response JSON bodies, and HTTP status codes for each endpoint",
    "Provide error response format for invalid requests"
  ],
  "deliverables": [
    "A JSON document containing the API design specification, including endpoints, HTTP methods, data model, and example request/response pairs",
    "Include status code mapping for common success and error scenarios"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "The design must be minimal, keeping endpoints to a single resource collection",
    "Must follow RESTful principles using standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE)",
    "Must use JSON for all request and response bodies, with Content-Type: application/json",
    "No authentication or authorization schemes should be included"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Task resource has fields: id (string, UUID), title (string, required), description (string, optional), completed (boolean, default false), createdAt (string, ISO 8601), updatedAt (string, ISO 8601)",
    "Base path is '/tasks'",
    "Use PATCH for partial updates instead of PUT for full replacement",
    "Use standard HTTP status codes: 200 for OK, 201 for Created, 204 for No Content, 400 for Bad Request, 404 for Not Found"
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "No user authentication, authorization, or ownership",
    "No persistence details, database schema, or storage implementation",
    "No pagination, filtering, or sorting of task lists",
    "No frontend or consumer code"
  ],
  "acceptance": [
    "The API design is provided as a JSON structure, with at least the following endpoints: GET /tasks, GET /tasks/{id}, POST /tasks, PATCH /tasks/{id}, DELETE /tasks/{id}",
    "The JSON structure includes a task data model with the seven fields listed",
    "The JSON structure specifies request/response examples for each endpoint",
    "The JSON structure includes a list of applicable HTTP status codes for each endpoint"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Ambiguity about required vs optional fields may cause implementation differences",
    "Minimalism may be interpreted differently; the exact set of endpoints could be expanded or reduced",
    "Without explicit error handling spec, API consumers may face inconsistent error formats"
  ]
}
